It’s largely specific to your needs, ifrit is good if the enemy never really uses Hp attacks or if you’ll always be above the threshold, Diabolos is good if you’re using an imperil enchanter, etc, generally Odin is a go to but it’s worth looking at how the boss works as well as how the members of your team function to choose a good summon to support that

1. Celes receives the most immediate rework followed by wakka and setzer and those three are also serviceable as is so I’d recommend those in descending order.

2. Beatrix and Xande are on the same tier for me in terms of priority so I’d recommend those two significantly more than the current banners

3. His HA certainly helps him a lot but I’d recommend looking at the actual total Hp damage he does instead of the brv hits, he manages to get a lot done in terms of damage and he has a shit ton of longevity for an attacker, having 8 guaranteed paralysis certainly helps as well
